data.title: The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Congratulates Sultan of Oman on National Day
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud has sent a cable of congratulations to Sultan Haitham bin Tarik of Oman on his country's National Day.
    The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques wished the sultan continued good health and happiness, and the government and people of Oman steady progress and prosperity.
    The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques also lauded the distinguished fraternal relations that bind the two countries and their peoples, which both sides are keen to boost in all fields.
    -- SPA
11:57 Local Time 08:57 GMT
